instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind Config: Add the custom colors (background, surface, text_primary, text_secondary, border, primary, danger, categories) to tailwind.config.js.
2. Fonts: Add @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500;600&family=Work+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap'); to index.css and map them in Tailwind config.
3. Icons: Install @phosphor-icons/react and lucide-react (if shadcn uses it).
4. Charts: Install recharts for the monthly report section.

5. App State (localStorage): Build a state management (e.g., Zustand or React Context) to manage: user name, selected currency, monthly salary, category percentage allocations, list of expenses (with date, desc, value, category), and selected month for the report.
6. Currency Formatting: Use Intl.NumberFormat to format values dynamically based on the selected currency (BRL, USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).
7. Initial Screen: If the user name is not found in localStorage, show a clean onboarding screen asking for Name.
8. Header: Display greeting 'Olá, {name}' on the left, and a currency selector dropdown on the right.

9. Dashboard Layout (Bento Grid): Top area for 'Remaining Balance' and total salary overview. Next row: Category percentage allocation inputs and budget cards (showing allocated amount based on %, and remaining after expenses). Next row: 'Add Expense' form and 'Recent Expenses' list.
10. Monthly Reports: A dedicated section at the bottom allowing month selection, showing a pie chart of expenses per category, and a bar chart comparing total expenses vs budget.
11. Testing: Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements (inputs, buttons, selects, list items).
